Try itDrive the ROSbot and watch the numbers

Each command on /cmd_vel is a TwistStamped: linear.x is the forward speed in m/s, angular.z the turn rate in rad/s (positive turns left).

try it Drag the knob: up and down set linear.x, left and right angular.z. Release it: both go back to 0.
